results.title: Dacula softball wins walk-off thriller over Hebron Christian
No. 3 Duke Opens Season with 3-1 Win at Southern California
results.description: Powered by three goals over the first 31 minutes of the contest, the third-ranked Duke women's soccer team opened the 2026 season with a 3-1 victory over Southern California Wednesday evening inside Rawlinson Stadium in Los Angeles.

results.title: New Lakers Owner Bob Iger Confirms Jeanie Buss’ Role With the Lakers After Mark Walter’s $12.5B Record Sale
results.description: The Lakers have changed hands again, but the franchise’s most familiar figure is not going anywhere just yet. A record $12.5 billion transaction has shifted majority control from Mark Walter to an ownership group led by Bob Iger and Josh Kushner.

results.title: Four years after COVID scrapped city's first attempt, Special Olympics finally underway in Medicine Hat
results.description: The Special Olympics Canada Summer Games opened in Medicine Hat this week, four years after the city’s first chance to host was cancelled because of COVID-19.
